notes.title: Apologies and Hopes: Updates and Future Changes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45223075/4f84ef9fd99a30a4fa02c57232bb50e655de1e17.png[/img]

Greetings to all.

First and foremost, I would like to apologize for the inconvenience caused. In the first few hours after the game's release, I failed to notice that I had uploaded a beta version, which in essence was nothing more than a non-functional product. I deeply regret this mistake and sincerely hope it will not happen again. I hope that the final release version of the game will meet your expectations, and I look forward to hearing your feedback and reviews.

Sincerely,
Hero.

P.S. A small rebranding is planned soon, so please stay tuned.
